subject: Error in converting data to telemetry

messages.author: 0cb1ab1dff2bfeb6
messages.subject: Error in converting data to telemetry
parts:
Hello, 

I've been playing around with creating home ranges in R in preparation for an upcoming research project and I seem to be having an issue with a dataset from movebank. When trying to convert the csv file to telemetry I get the following error (script included):


dragon<-read.csv("Dragons (Calotes versicolor), Balouch et al., Pakistan.csv")
dragon<-as.telemetry(dragon, timeformat="auto", timezone="UTC", projection=NULL, datum=NULL, timeout=Inf, na.rm="row", mark.rm=FALSE, keep=FALSE, drop=TRUE)


Minimum sampling interval of NA in NA Error in `[<-`(`*tmp*`, "all", "horizontal", value = median(CAL)) : subscript out of bounds




I've gotten the same error with other movebank datasets so I'm not sure if the error lies with the datasets or me. Thanks for any help!
